review.status: frozen independent narrow source review; zero readonly-rotation blockers identified; one budget-coverage limitation noted

confirmed.fact: prepare_outputs retains the original Program, Run, result slot and endpoint. Closed/failed/pending/observer/retiring/completion-owner and original ResultSlot gates precede mutation. Retired input detachment forces rearm of owned output blocks rather than absorbing changed private counts into a writable baseline.

Only original owned nonconstant/non-input roots can rotate. A complete storage block is replaced and every alias rooted in it is rebuilt as a new Buffer object. Old exported Buffer/view objects remain unchanged. One unique unescaped whole spare may be reused; otherwise a fresh block uses the original Run allocation resource/budget. No overwrite of a still-owned spare or unbounded internal epoch list.

Failed cold preparation/rebinding keeps bound=false and composition_preparing/output_epoch_pending, blocking submit. A partially exported unpublished epoch can be retried without rotating again. Only a successful full bind plus original seal/reseal clears this state.

The complete prospective descriptor set is range-validated before updates. Static as well as dynamic bindings are refreshed, including native child dispatches through local-to-parent IDs. Managed and IREE stages retain their existing bind paths; required command re-encoding remains governed by original feature/origin rules.

Unbind validate keeps actual retirement, ResultSlot and managed-can-detach gates. Its release performs no explicit new vector/backing allocation, retracts source/import owners and marks the output epoch non-submit-ready. It does not infer a new baseline from surviving external owners.

Graph refresh prepares every export transactionally before replacing existing stable port objects. Deferred generated output kinds force native prepare_bindings each binding episode even when input tuples are unchanged, including zero-input producer regions.
Original IREE input bind reads current parent carriers and copy_result selects current parent destination. This is supporting source evidence only, not a new IREE runtime pass.

limitation_requiring_scope_clarity.kind: Vulkan same-backing retained-budget dedup is not implemented by this six-file readonly-rotation change
limitation_requiring_scope_clarity.fact: Every output lease export still creates a fresh AllocationToken and ReadLease domain. The device MemoryResource does not advertise canonical host address identity. Generic retain_budget therefore accounts independent domains separately; it cannot prove multiple logical aliases/exports share one original VkBuffer. A view Buffer extent may also differ from its full root allocation extent.
limitation_requiring_scope_clarity.effect: Does not invalidate readonly output byte stability or original-Run rearm, but this source cannot certify Vulkan exact-once full shared-backing retention accounting. The AK design already identified a trusted native root/full-backing annotation seam for this separate requirement. Do not reinterpret the raw AllocationToken pointer or remove permission/retirement checks.
